name: Oasis Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Oasis Securities Ltd is a non deposit taking NBFC organization.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company was in the business of Stock Broking and Financial Services. It later sold its NSE broking business and Depository business and ceased to be  a Depository Participant of NSDL. At present, company is providing services viz.,
a) Mutual Fund Distribution
b) IPO activities
c) Life Insurance
d) Other Investment options
e) Offering of Loans

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 132 days to 40.8 days
cons: Stock is trading at 2.67 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.37% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.45% over last 3 years.
